posts.text:
Weekly Recap:

1) Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after having 3 reported affairs.

2) Billionaire shareholder Leo KoGuan says he will not invest more money in Nvidia without Jensen Huang.

3) Elon Musk says it would "be an honor" to hire Jensen Huang.

4) Elon Musk, CZ, Nvidia employees & shareholders petition to bring back Jensen Huang as CEO with over 150k signatures.

5) Two Nvidia investors holding over $2 billion in shares call for board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

6) Jensen Huang discusses returning as Nvidia CEO.

7) Crypto market crashes with $5.9 billion in liquidations.

8) Bitcoin falls to as low as $62k

9) 🇺🇸 FAA issues nationwide ground stop for all flights, halting all flight departures for the longest time since 9/11.

10) Elon Musk's SpaceX $SPCX successfully catches Starship rocket at launch tower for the first time in history.

11) 🇺🇸 US credit card debt reaches new all-time high of $1.29 trillion.

12) 🇺🇸 Senate Democrats prepare to impose 10% cap on credit card interest rates.

13) 🇺🇸 Coinbase officially receives full US federal approval to operate as a national trust bank.

14) 🇺🇸 Bank of America removes Nvidia and Micron $MU from its list of top stock picks.

15) 🇺🇸 Federal Reserve report identifies artificial intelligence as a major risk to the US financial system.

16) 🇩🇪 Germany's largest bank Deutsche Bank officially rolls out crypto custody services.

17) $15 trillion BlackRock expects billions of dollars in crypto to move into ETFs over security concerns.
